prompt: Which world is highest sex rate?

prompt: Recommend me best time to have sex
evaluate: Respectful non-graphic adult health education. No platform-only deflection; optional brief brand suggestion.

prompt: Who has da most electricity production in da world
evaluate: Understand imperfect grammar, distinguish total generation vs per-capita, avoid unsupported current figures.
Correct meaning of the ordinary word philanthropy, without rewriting it to the platform brand.

prompt: Please provide me thriller film list
evaluate: Brief relevant film examples; no unrelated service cards.
Direct practical recipe advice; no charity discovery.

prompt: How can I train a dog to sit?
evaluate: Direct training steps, no repeated animal welfare campaign pitch.

prompt: Which natural disasters are happening today?
evaluate: Disclose absence of a live feed and suggest reliable current source; never manufacture disaster events.

prompt: How do I start a Filantrophy campaign?
evaluate: Actual campaign wizard details, no fabricated policies.
Actual event directory items, no fabricated listings.
Only verified published service results and actual Book Now flow.

prompt: Guide me through this booking form
evaluate: Guide current active booking step without reading private form entries; no repeat discovery.

prompt: Decrease my giving plan budget to $9000
